title: Water-quality reports
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Obtain the water test results and analyze them.
3. Identify which parameters failed the required standards.
4. Confirm the failures with the laboratory.
5. Clarify the potential health impacts with public health experts.
6. Format the report clearly and concisely.
7. Include a summary at the beginning for quick understanding.
8. Detail each failed test parameter and the specific standard it did not meet.
9. Provide the date and time of sampling and testing.
10. State the name and location of the water supply affected.

11. Describe the follow-up actions proposed or taken.
12. Instruct public on relevant precautions to avoid health hazards.
13. Explain any corrective measures undertaken to resolve the issue.
14. Indicate the timeline for retesting and verification.
15. Offer contact information for further inquiries.
16. Implement जनता को सचेत करने के लिए सूचनात्मक बुलेटिन and public advisories.
17.
